title: National Ranching Heritage Center

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: to the National Ranching Heritage Center offer students a chance to experience history and ranch life firsthand. Through interactive exhibits and outdoor exploration, students gain a deeper understanding of how ranching shaped the land, economy, and culture of the American West. Each field trip complements classroom learning and provides hands-on opportunities for discovery across science, social studies, and literacy. Reservations are required for all field trips to the NRHC. Visits are free of charge, and space is available for student lunches. Choose between touring the Proctor Historical Park, the Cash Family Ranch Life Learning Center featuring Hank the Cowdog, or both!

services.name: facilities rental
services.desc: The National Ranching Heritage Center is a great place for you to hold special events such as receptions, dinners, parties, and workshops. As a museum and department within Texas Tech University, NRHC policies and procedures differ from those of hotels, restaurants, clubs or convention centers. All of our lessons, activities, and field trip resources are free, but you’ll need to log in or create a free educator account to fetch ’em. Once you’re logged in, you’ll have the run of the ranch-access to classroom downloads, field trip tools, and new resources as they roll
